question: What is introduction?
answer: The Timesheet module in Quotelan is designed to record the time spent by employees on different tasks, projects, or activities. It helps organizations track labor hours, billable and non-billable hours, leave, overtime (OT), double time (DT), triple time (TT), and payroll processes. Timesheet module is also used to track punch-in/punch-out (in and out entry) of every employee to the company. Timesheets can be created, modified, approved, rejected, reset, copied, and exported based on user permissions.

User can fill timesheet for PTO labor code 6 months in advance. For any other labor code, system will generate message You can only create and submit PTO 6 months in advance. Select a Project from the Project dropdown. User can see only specific projects for which user is assigned. User can select only labor codes assigned for that user for that project. Also user can select assigned tasks for that project. User-labor, user-task, task-labor permissions are assigned in project module - project settings. Select a Task from the Task dropdown. question: What is the system automatically performs both row-level and timesheet-level calculations, including?

Eg: $100 for customer support - this will show 100 in supplemental bonus ) All calculations are dynamically recalculated whenever hours or configuration values change.

question: What is row management behavior?
answer: After creating or opening a timesheet, users can add, edit, or delete rows. Row deletion is allowed before emailing the timesheet. After a row is deleted, all dependent calculated fields (such as Billable and Non-Billable hours) are recalculated automatically. When the Project field is changed in a row, all dependent fields (Labor, Task, Type, Hours, and Billable flag) are reset to avoid invalid data mapping. If a row contains zero hours, the system triggers a confirmation alert before saving. The Hours field accepts numeric values only
